description: This file contains shell functions for platform-specific operations related to image verification, copying configurations, and upgrading the device. It handles tasks such as checking image partition layout, copying configuration files, and performing the upgrade process including partition and bootloader updates.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the partition layout of an image matches the existing device, outputs a warning if it has changed.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies backup configuration files to the partition mounted at /mnt.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a full device upgrade, including partition table validation, image writing, bootloader update, and partition data.
